# Aim

In this exercise you will use the Datasaurus Dozen to see why visualisation is necessary even when summary statistics look identical.

By the end, you should have compared summary statistics with plots and explained why looking at the data visually can change what we understand from the same numbers.

The Datasaurus Dozen shows several datasets with very similar summary statistics but very different visual patterns [@matejka2017same]. It extends the same lesson as Anscombe's quartet [@anscombe1973graphs; @tufte1989].

# Replace x = ___ with x = x and y = ___ with y = y.
# facet_wrap(~dataset) makes one panel for each dataset.
# Replace method = "___" with method = "lm" for a linear model.

  facet_wrap(~dataset, labeller = label_both) +
  geom_smooth(method = "___", fullrange = TRUE, se = FALSE)
